Test that the controls attribute is not affected by fullscreen

EVENT(loadeddata)
EXPECTED (video.controls == 'false') OK
RUN(video.webkitRequestFullscreen())
EVENT(webkitfullscreenchange)
EXPECTED (video.controls == 'false') OK
END OF TEST
